Axios Pro Rata
By Lucinda Shen · Nov 16, 2026

Lucinda here, reporting in from Helsinki (if you're also here for Slush, join my club of woefully underdressed foreigners). Dan returns tomorrow, where you can find him at BFD in New York.
Share today’s Axios Pro Rata
 
 
Top of the Morning
 

Photo illustration: Sarah Grillo/Axios. Photo: David Paul Morris/Bloomberg via Getty Images
 

That was fast. Days after resigning as Nvidia's CEO, Jensen Huang is discussing a comeback with his allies, the Financial Times reports.

Why it matters: There are few CEOs that are as key as Huang is their company and to the broader AI economy.

  • He was the face, the financier, and a technical kingpin.

Zoom in: Huang apparently is willing to return, and tech investors and executives have given him plenty of support, but any return will depend on the board and Washington, D.C.

  • Huang's central issue will be explaining how chips ended up in China — and to what extent the company has liability on that end. Plus, the open question remains of whether Alice Huang was a spy (a label that has faced pushback, with no definitive conclusion on her risk level by U.S. officials).
  • There's also politics at play here. Prominent MAGA figures have seized on Huang's fallout to try and pull President Trump away from the tech right.

Shares of the company fell sharply after Huang's ouster, and they opened down about 2% today. That reflects the uncertainty investors feel around his potential return, and the near-term velocity of the company as it handles the scandal's fallout.

What we're watching: Huang has agreed to testify before Congress, but the timing has not been set. The Nvidia board has also initiated an independent review.

The bottom line: "If after all the facts are known the Board decides that it is not in shareholders' best interest to have Jensen Huang back as CEO, that is the Board's prerogative," Altimeter CEO and Nvidia shareholder Brad Gerstner wrote in a letter last week.
 
 
The BFD
 

Illustration: Tiffany Herring/Axios
 

Stark Future, a Barcelona-based electric motorcycle company, raised $165 million at a $1.32 billion pre-money valuation.

Why it's the BFD: This comes as the global fuel crisis, set off by the Iran War, drives up demand for electric vehicles of all shapes and sizes.

Zoom in: Stark is the continent's first unicorn in the space, as its valuation revved up 60% from its last round in September 2025.

  • Highland Europe led the round, with participation from Morgan Stanley Investment Management's 1GT climate strategy and Axon Partners Group.

What we're watching: Mahindra Last Mile Mobility, an Indian electric three-wheeler business backed by Mahindra & Mahindra and Lightrock, is weighing an IPO in 18 months, Bloomberg reports.

 
 
Venture Capital Deals
 

• Kalshi, an NYC-based prediction markets company, is in talks to raise fresh funds at a $65b valuation, per Reuters. axios.link/4iR1eet

• Applied Intuition, a Sunnyvale, Calif.-based autonomous-vehicle software maker, is in talks to raise $1.5b at a $30b valuation per Bloomberg. General Catalyst is slated to lead. axios.link/4C2qTJN

• Firmus, an Australian neocloud, is looking to raise US$3b in equity and debt after the collapse of its $29.7b ASX listing, per the AFR. axios.link/48rSl6j

• Corma, an Israeli cybersecurity AI lab, raised a $125m Series A round at a $1b valuation. NEA led, joined by Sequoia Capital, Khosla Ventures, and Coatue. axios.link/4zPTgtq

🚑 Vumedi, an Oakland, Calif.-based peer-to-peer learning community for physicians, raised $104m in Series B funding from Oak HC/FT. axios.link/48iybM4

🚑 Seawolf Therapeutics, a gene-editing biotech developing therapies for bleeding disorders, raised $100m in funding in a seed (led by Versant Ventures) and Series A round (led by Eli Lilly and the Novartis Venture Fund). Versant, MPM BioImpact, CRISPR Therapeutics, Sixty Degree Capital, Alexandria Venture Investments and Pathway to Cures joined the Series A. axios.link/3WyGqB4

• Index Industries, a company creating real estate indexes akin to ETFs, raised $50m in seed funding led by Lightspeed Venture Partners. Galaxy Ventures, Wintermute Ventures and Polychain Capital joined. axios.link/4C4gQ6Z

🚑 Orakl Oncology, a Paris-based cancer outcome prediction platform, raised $34m in Series A funding co-led by Norrsken VC and Singular. InfraVia, Serena, the Patient Autonome Fund managed by Bpifrance, teampact.ventures, Plug and Play, Verve Ventures, Speedinvest, and HCVC joined. axios.link/4kZBgIa

⚡Intergrid, a Helsinki-based industrial energy management company, raised €23.5m. Its most recent round was co-led by Kvanted and Tesi. True Ventures, Lifeline Ventures, and First Fellow Partners joined. axios.link/4kisogL

• Bharat Semi, an Indian semiconductor startup, raised $24m in seed funding for AI-enabled image sensors. Info Edge Group, South Park Commons, and Indus Bridge Ventures led. Valour Capital, Micromax, and Gaingels joined. axios.link/3WK8NMH

• Alecto, a London-based consumer law firm using AI, raised a $20m seed. Insight Partners led, joined by Firstminute Capital, Blue Lion Global, Andrena Ventures, FJ Labs, Antiportfolio Ventures, Rigby Group and Mishcon de Reya. axios.link/4AquRKA

• 4Minds, a Dallas-based contextual platform for enterprises, raised a $15m Series A at a $500m valuation. Investors include Waterwood Capital Group and Isom Holdings. axios.link/3WLQbMc

• Valeria, a Barcelona-based HR and payroll management platform targeting companies with high turnover, raised €5.5m in seed funding led by BlackFin. VentureFriends, Fortino, and GoHub joined. axios.link/48hqN3x

• Mosaico, an Italy-based open-source robotics data startup, raised €7.5m in seed funding led by United Ventures. OpenOcean and Connect Ventures joined. mosaico.dev

• Ulys, an NYC-based AI investing startup, raised $4m led by Streamlined Ventures. Tom Lee of Fundstrat, BitMine, and XBTO Ventures joined. axios.link/3V39LmH
 
 
Private Equity Deals
 

• Birch Hill Equity Partners acquired TruGreen, a Franklin, Tenn.-based lawn care services provider from Clayton, Dubilier & Rice. axios.link/4zj4aqg

• Blackstone's latest offer to buy out Australia's IDP Education (ASX: IEL), valuing it at A$833.7m ($564.5m) was rebuffed. axios.link/4zQKHi3

• Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust agreed to acquire a 75% stake in two JVs with Amazon Web Services, in a deal valued at about $5b. axios.link/4zVzXis

• Centerbridge ⁠Partners and Mubadala will take Canaccord Genuity's British wealth management ​business private at a $1.55b valuation. Canaccord expects shareholders to receive £564m for the transaction. It paves the way for CEO Dan Daviau to take the Canadian firm private. axios.link/4fcAN1H

• CD&R and GTCR reportedly dropped their pursuit of a Global Payments (NYSE: GPN) take-private, per Reuters. The company is valued at about $26.4b. axios.link/4iHEtL7

• H.I.G. Small-Cap & Growth launched Waveborn, a platform built to consolidate the creator economy. It acquired Jake Rosen Entertainment, an NYC-based creator management firm. axios.link/4zia9f2

🚑 Inovalon, backed by Nordic Capital, acquired DrFirst, a clinical workflow and analytics company. axios.link/4kfZnCo

🚑 PAI Pharma, a portfolio company of Olympus Partners, acquired Nexus Pharmaceuticals, a pharmaceutical company specializing in the development and commercialization of injectable medicines. axios.link/4eBePoY

• RedBird Capital Partners launched Milan Sports & Entertainment, a holding company for its Milan-based investments in sports, infrastructure, and live events. axios.link/4iTUnRw

• Sutherland Holdings International invested in InsightEx, a U.K.-based training provider and engineering consultancy specializing in hazardous-area certification. axios.link/4jgGYnP

Wind Point Partners acquired Chroma Color Corporation, a McHenry, Ill.-based plastics concentrate maker, from Arsenal Capital Partners. axios.link/4fB16Pg
 
 
Public Offerings
 

Anthropic is expected to price its U.S. IPO on Wednesday, the sole company on the calendar this week.

🚑 Leo Pharma, a Denmark-based pharmaceuticals company, plans to delay its IPO beyond 2026. Backers include LEO Foundation and Nordic Capital. axios.link/4iMbBBp
 
 
Liquidity Events
 

⚡ Diamondback Energy (Nasdaq: FANG) is nearing a deal to buy assets from Double Eagle IV, a Double Eagle drilling portfolio backed by EnCap, for roughly $5b, potentially extending its reach in the Permian Basin in Texas. axios.link/4C47gB1

• EMCOR Group agreed to acquire P1 Construction, a Lenaxa, Kan.-based mechanical and electrical contractor across the Midwestern U.S. backed by Dunes Point Capital. axios.link/4AqWWBx

🚑 Farmacias del Ahorro agreed to acquire 96.56% of Farmacias Benavides, a Mexico-based pharmacy chain, from Sycamore Partners-backed Boots Group. axios.link/4AzRM6A
 
 
More M&A
 

🚑 The FTC has sued to block Covetrus' $3.5b acquisition of Cencora's MWI Veterinary Supply, a supplier of pharmaceuticals and vaccines to veterinarians. axios.link/4f57xKc

⚡Canadian Natural Resources (TO: CNQ) will ‌acquire Advantage Energy (TO: AAV), a smaller Canadian oil and gas producer, for C$2.5b ($1.8b) ​including debt. axios.link/48Fu7Wt

• Johnson & Johnson agreed to acquire Austin, Texas-based eye disease biotech Ollin Biosciences for $2.2 billion upfront, plus up to $1.1 billion in milestone payments. Ollin had raised roughly $340 million from Monograph Capital, Mubadala Capital and TCG Crossover Management. axios.link/4zRakza

• Blackstone concurrently will provide $750m in development funding to J&J to support the Phase 3 clinical development of Ollin's drug candidate. axios.link/4iK0iK2

• Novelis, a U.S. aluminum producer owned by India's Hindalco, agreed to sell two of its Chinese subsidiaries for $265m. axios.link/4AsWxP4
 
 
Fundraising
 

• Gemspring Capital Management raised $3.5b for its fourth buyout fund. gemspring.com

🚑 Sofinnova Partners raised €725m ($815m) for its second clinical-stage fund. axios.link/4AztZ6K

• Plural raised €1b ($1.1b) for its third fund. Two-thirds is earmarked for early-stage, and the rest to select follow-on investments. axios.link/4fyAPRD
 
 
It's Personnel
 

• Haya Hanna, a former Hummingbird Ventures investor, is in early talks to raise her own fund, per Sifted. axios.link/4zO7ta5

• Jun Ohashi was appointed chairman of Japan at General Atlantic. axios.link/4kjoHra

• Carlota Thévenot joined The Auréa Group as a partner in Paris. aureagroup.com
 
 
Final Numbers
 
Data: Pitchbook; Note: SpaceXAI, Lumentum, and Naver are public. Anthropic is going public, with indications of pricing around $1 trillion.; Table: Lucinda Shen/Axios

Nvidia has made equity investments in over 300 companies over its history, data from PitchBook shows, with its current portfolio spanning some of the most significant AI player today.

  • In its most recent earnings report, the company reported that the value of its equity investments had reach $99 billion, with commitments of $25 billion pending.
